a.lede: The company will be the first true artificial intelligence company to go public as tech firms continue to invest heavily in AI.
a.title: Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing

b.lede: Anthropic has filed to go public as it pursues a potential multitrillion-dollar valuation, reporting $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026. The company’s filing also warns that its AI safety measures may not prevent catastrophic risks. OpenAI and AI chipmaker Cerebras have also pursued public-market listings
b.title: Anthropic prepares for potential $2 trillion IPO valuation after reporting billions in revenue
